content.jointProblem: Can recommendations based on product descriptions and category metadata, optionally combined with sparse purchase signals, outperform best-seller sorting for one Harmat client with only 500–2,000 transactions? The first experiment would test transfer from audio-description recommendation to product catalogs by comparing simple content-based methods, pretrained semantic embeddings and a lightweight hybrid against best-seller sorting, using time-held-out transactions and human relevance judgments while quantifying uncertainty.

rationale.text: Zahorecová has developed a description-embedding recommendation prototype and evaluated recommendations with users, directly supporting investigation of content-based alternatives to sparse collaborative filtering.

sources.quote: Razvijen je prototip sistema za preporučivanje podkast epizoda koji koristi semantička ugrađivanja opisa epizoda za računanje srodnosti sadržaja.
Evaluacija je sprovedena sa 87 dobrovoljnih korisnika u kontrolisanom okruženju

rationale.text: Her work compares inexpensive lexical similarity with sentence embeddings for short descriptions, providing relevant methods for testing whether semantic models add value over simpler product-text baselines.

sources.quote: We benchmarked eight similarity methods ranging from cosine similarity over TF-IDF vectors to sentence-level embeddings produced by a fine-tuned multilingual BERT variant.

rationale.text: She has studied Serbian–Hungarian metadata representations, relevant to investigating multilingual product descriptions in Harmat's regional market, though not evidence of validated retail performance.

sources.quote: This paper investigates the effectiveness of Word2Vec skip-gram embeddings trained on bilingual corpora of Serbian and Hungarian audio metadata

rationale.text: She has prior industrial experience delivering a recommendation prototype that entered internal use and defining annotation requirements, supporting a scoped prototype and relevance-labeling exercise.

sources.quote: tokom kojeg je razvijen prototip sistema za preporučivanje koji je ušao u internu upotrebu.
Ima iskustvo u definisanju zahteva za anotaciju podataka i upravljanju procesima anotacije u industrijskom okruženju.

constraints.text: The experiment must work with existing sparse data rather than depend on collecting substantially more transactions, and must retain best-seller sorting as a baseline.

sources.quote: We do not have the budget or the traffic to wait for larger datasets.
Simple best-seller sorting actually outperformed the model in our A/B test

constraints.text: Data access must be covered by a data-sharing agreement and limited to the offered anonymised transaction and catalog data unless additional access is explicitly agreed.

sources.quote: We can give a collaborator full read access to anonymised transaction and product catalogue data.
access to anonymised client datasets under a data-sharing agreement.

constraints.text: Scope must fit approximately one developer-day per week from Harmat, initially targeting one client's prototype rather than a multi-client production rollout.

sources.quote: We can allocate one mid-level developer for roughly one day per week to an applied research collaboration
A working prototype for one client would be enough to start.

constraints.text: Any deployable prototype must accommodate Harmat's existing integration and client-VPS environment; inference resources and latency limits need agreement before choosing a model.

sources.quote: WooCommerce and custom REST API integrations
Docker for containerised deployments on client VPS environments

constraints.text: User-facing additions must follow Harmat's three-language review process; which catalog languages the pilot must support remains to be established.

sources.quote: we test every user-facing string in all three languages before a build ships

constraints.text: Scheduling must respect the researcher's stated earliest start of mid-2027; her actual current availability and committed effort still require confirmation.

sources.quote: dostupna je za nove projekte koji bi počeli najranije sredinom 2027. godine.

risks: Audio and podcast recommendation results do not establish retail recommendation quality. Semantic similarity may identify substitutes when shoppers need complementary products; the first experiment must test both relevance and intended recommendation type on the chosen catalog.

The researcher's behavior-supervised embedding study used 4.2 million session records, unlike Harmat's small order histories. Training a similar behavioral model may be infeasible; the pilot should first test content-only methods and whether sparse purchase signals add any value.
Low transaction volume may make held-out estimates unstable and prevent a timely, adequately powered online comparison. Offline relevance improvements would not establish sales uplift.
Product-description completeness, category consistency, catalog size and language distribution are unknown. Poor metadata or untested Slovak coverage could undermine semantic recommendations.
Joint-project participation is open, but current researcher capacity, project budget, pilot deadline and hardware limits remain unknown. The stated mid-2027 start may not match Harmat's needs.
questions: Can Zahorecová confirm a start no earlier than mid-2027, available effort and willingness to undertake this retail recommendation joint project?
Which client and catalog will be used, how many active products are present, and how complete are descriptions, categories, language variants and historical catalog snapshots?
Should the widget recommend substitutes, complementary products or both, and who can label a small set of product–recommendation pairs for the first transfer experiment?
Do the anonymised data retain order timestamps, basket membership and stable product identifiers? Are historical impressions or clicks available, and what exactly did the earlier A/B test measure?
What minimum improvement would justify deployment, which offline and business metrics matter, and is there enough traffic for a later online test within an agreed time window?
What budget, deadline, VPS resources, response-time limits and integration responsibilities can each partner commit to?
What data-sharing, retention, access-control and model-hosting terms must be agreed, including whether external embedding services are permitted?
